reviews.explanation: The mention '溪狗' is a derogatory nickname used by Tao Gong (陶公) to refer to Wen Qiao (温嶠/温忠武). The main text states '温曰溪狗我所悉' — Wen says 'I know this Xigou well,' referring to himself or being referred to. The context clearly shows 温忠武 (Wen Zhongwu) is the speaker, and the nickname '溪狗' is used by Tao Gong to refer to Wen. The candidate evidence sfh1-candidate-evidence-23c3b45db9966528891a shows '温' matching the name 温嶠, and the reference semantics correctly identify this as coreferent with 温忠武 and 温. The distinctness from 庾文康, 陶公, and 蘇峻 is well-supported by the context. The evidence specifically supports the identity of Wen Qiao.

The mention '陶公' is an honorific reference to 陶侃 (Tao Kan). The main text says '温忠武與庾文康投陶公求救' — Wen Zhongwu and Yu Wenkang sought help from Tao Gong. The candidate evidence from aliases.json shows the full context where 陶公 is used consistently. The annotation-003 mentions '侃' (Kan), the personal name of Tao Kan, confirming the identity. The evidence specifically supports that 陶公 refers to 陶侃.

The evidence specifically supports this identity.

The mention '陶' is the surname abbreviation within the honorific '陶公', referring to 陶侃. In the main text, '温勸庾見陶' — Wen urged Yu to see Tao — clearly refers to the same person as 陶公 (Tao Kan).
